EX series

EX Trainer Kit Latios

Released June 1, 2004 · 10 cards

EX Trainer Kit Latios is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the EX series, released in English on June 1, 2004. It has 10 cards. It includes 7 Pokémon, 2 Trainer and 1 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

8 illustrators worked on EX Trainer Kit Latios. Most cards: Ken Sugimori (2), Atsuko Nishida (1), Kai Ishikawa (1), Keiji Kinebuchi (1), Kyoko Koizumi (1), Kyoko Umemoto (1), Mitsuhiro Arita (1), Tomokazu Komiya (1).
